title: Book Three · Chapter 79: Three Rings
story:
Two weeks later, spring brings a warm Saturday.

Ronan meets Anna, Kai, and Lin near the market. The heavy coats stay at home. Anna takes his hand as they start along the stalls.

Kai looks at their hands, then at the bags of food.

“One free hand each,” he says. “Bad shopping.”

“We can share the bags,” Anna answers.

Lin laughs and points toward a stall with wooden posts. A man stands behind it with a box of rings.

One small coin buys three throws. A ring around the narrow post wins a paper flower.

Ronan checks his pocket. He has kept a little money for the morning. Most of his savings are still at home.

“One try,” he says.

He pays and takes three rings. The first goes too far. The second hits the post and falls beside it.

Kai bends his knees to look along the last ring.

“Lower.”

“You can throw with your own arm,” Ronan says.

Kai steps back, grinning. Anna waits beside Lin.

Ronan looks at the post and throws. The ring drops over the top and settles around it.

The man lifts a paper flower from the box.

“Choose a colour.”

Ronan looks at Anna.

“Yellow,” she says.

He gives her the flower. She puts it through a buttonhole on her light coat.

“A very useful plant,” Kai says.

“No water,” Lin answers.

They move away before Ronan buys another turn. His three rings are back in the box. The one flower is enough for today.

At the next stall, Lin looks for a notebook. Kai wants to see the small tools farther down. They agree to meet near the bread shop in a little while.

Ronan and Anna take the slower side of the market.

A gust of wind bends one paper petal. Anna presses it back into shape with her thumb.

“Already needs work,” Ronan says.

“I can manage a flower.”

She reaches for his hand again.

They stop at a stall of old picture books. Anna looks at one with city buildings on the cover. Ronan looks at a book of boats beside it.

Neither buys a book. They open a few pages, thank the woman, and go on.

Near the bread shop, Kai is waiting with Lin. He has bought nothing either. Lin has a plain notebook under one arm.

“A good morning?” Kai asks.

Anna touches the yellow flower. “A successful garden.”

Ronan laughs. They walk together toward the crossing. The flower moves in the warm air, and Anna holds it safe with her free hand.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

post＝竖杆；ring＝圆环；buttonhole＝扣眼；petal＝花瓣。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan花钱玩了几轮？他有没有继续花掉全部存款？
2. 四个人有没有必须始终做同一件事？Anna怎样照看纸花？

## 读句子

**The ring drops over the top and settles around it.**

拆开看：The ring / drops over the top / and settles around it.

圆环／从杆顶落下／套在杆子周围。
